text:
```yaml
name: Lint, Style, and Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up R
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: 'release'

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          dependencies: "Imports, Suggests"
          extra-packages: "lintr, styler, testthat, devtools"

      - name: Create .lintr configuration
        run: |
          cat > .lintr <<'EOF'
          lintr::lintr(
            linters = list(
              indentation_linter = lintr::indentation_linter(width = 2, tab = FALSE)
            )
          )
          EOF

      - name: Run lintr
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'if (length(lintr::lint_package()) > 0) stop("Lint errors detected")'

      - name: Style package
        run: Rscript -e 'styler::style_pkg()'

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all(); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-huxtable-creation.R")'
```
